description: Test vectors for gacha roller: weighted random distribution, pity trigger, rate display

cases.name: pity_triggers_at_threshold
cases.description: After 9 non-5-star pulls (pity_count=9), the 10th pull must be 5-star

cases.name: pity_does_not_trigger_below_threshold
cases.description: At pity_count=8, normal weighted random applies

cases.name: pity_resets_on_top_rarity
cases.description: Getting a 5-star naturally resets pity to 0

cases.name: displayed_rates_match_weights
cases.description: Rate display should show percentage based on entry weights

cases.name: multi_pull_pity_tracks_across_pulls
cases.description: In a 10-pull starting at pity=7, pull 3 is forced 5-star (pity reaches 9)
cases.comment: Pull 1: pity=7→8 (if not 5*), Pull 2: pity=8→9 (if not 5*), Pull 3: pity=9→forced 5*, reset to 0

cases.name: weighted_distribution_statistical
cases.description: Over 10000 rolls with pity_count=0 (no pity), distribution should approximate weights

cases.name: empty_pool_handling
cases.description: Rolling from a pool with no entries should fail gracefully
